en_title: GTA 6 on Switch 2? 'That's a Conversation for Take-Two and Rockstar,' Nintendo Says
subtitle: 目前无可奉告
opus_summary: 对于《GTA6》是否登陆Switch 2，美国任天堂总裁表示，这要由Take-Two和Rockstar商谈，目前没有消息可公布。她重申任天堂希望提供多样化游戏体验。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo of America president Devon Pritchard recently spoke about the company's plans, from theme parks to first- and third-party games. And with the launch of Switch 2, the door is open to more third-party games that previously skipped Nintendo consoles (Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is one example). So what about GTA 6?
paragraphs.cn: 美国任天堂总裁Devon Pritchard近日谈到了公司的计划，内容涵盖主题公园以及第一方和第三方游戏。随着Switch 2推出，更多此前未登陆任天堂主机的第三方游戏也有了登陆的机会，《使命召唤：现代战争4》就是其中之一。那么，《GTA6》呢？

paragraphs.en: The Switch 2 is of course more powerful than its predecessor, capable of running games like Cyberpunk 2077 and the recent The Witcher 3 remaster. But could it run GTA 6? And, if so, will Rockstar Games release a Switch 2 port? After all, it's coming out on the less powerful Xbox Series S next month.
paragraphs.cn: Switch 2的性能当然比前代更强，能够运行《赛博朋克2077》和最近推出的《巫师3》复刻版等游戏。但它能运行《GTA6》吗？如果能，Rockstar会推出Switch 2移植版吗？毕竟，这款游戏下个月就要登陆性能更弱的XBOX Series S了。

paragraphs.en: “That’s going to be a conversation for Take-Two and Rockstar, but nothing to announce on my end at this time,” Pritchard told Variety when asked about GTA 6 on Switch 2. Bah!
paragraphs.cn: 当《综艺》问到《GTA6》是否会登陆Switch 2时，Pritchard表示：「这要由Take-Two和Rockstar商谈，不过我这边目前没有消息可以公布。」唉！

paragraphs.en: Rockstar games Red Dead Redemption, Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition, and L.A. Noire are already on Switch, but the developer hasn’t announced anything about Red Dead Redemption 2, never mind GTA 6. Would Manhunt be asking too much? Rockstar’s sequel, Manhunt 2 , famously featured platform-specific controls for pummeling in heads with the motion controllers, and that’d work nicely on Switch 2 and make any onlookers afraid of taking me on when I play it on the train.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar旗下的《荒野大镖客：救赎》《侠盗猎车手：三部曲—最终版》和《L.A. Noire》已经登陆Switch，但这家开发商尚未公布《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的相关消息，更别提《GTA6》了。想要《Manhunt》也登陆，会不会太贪心？Rockstar的续作《Manhunt 2》有个知名特色：玩家可以利用特定平台的体感控制器，做出猛击敌人头部的动作。这套操作放在Switch 2上应该很合适，而且当我在火车上玩时，旁观者恐怕都不敢来招惹我。

paragraphs.en: “We have historically said that Nintendo is for ages 5 to 95, and that continues to be true,” Pritchard said. “We want to provide a diversity in terms of the types of experiences that you can have on the game system, and that’s really important for us.”
paragraphs.cn: Pritchard说：「我们一直说，任天堂面向5至95岁的玩家，这一点至今没有改变。我们希望玩家能在这台游戏主机上获得多样化的体验，这对我们非常重要。」

paragraphs.en: Nintendo’s upcoming The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launches on November 5, just two weeks before the launch of GTA 6. It’s about as close to Rockstar’s launch any triple-A game has dared, but Nintendo knows it has a captive audience of dedicated fans who love its stuff.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂即将推出的《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版将于11月5日发售，仅比《GTA6》早两周。在敢于挨近Rockstar新作发售日的3A游戏中，这几乎已经是最近的距离了。不过，任天堂知道，自己有一批忠实粉丝，始终喜爱它的作品。

paragraphs.en: A recent SNL skit parodied the double-bill gaming launches , calling it video games’ Barbenheimer. The one-two punch of Zelda and GTA 6 toward the end of the year really tops off a fantastic year in video games.
paragraphs.cn: 《周六夜现场》最近的一段短剧拿这两款游戏接连发售的安排开了个玩笑，称其为游戏界的「芭比海默」。年末《塞尔达》和《GTA6》接连登场，确实为游戏界这精彩的一年画上了圆满的句号。

paragraphs.en: We’ve had good friend times with Big Walk , industry leading combat in Onimusha: Way of the Sword , the first essential Bond game since GoldenEye with 007: First Light , the tantalising tactics and deep social mechanics of Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Wave , and loads more. It feels like we’re at that time in the console cycle where the developers have learned how to get the most out of the machines, and now we’re seeing what everyone can really do.
paragraphs.cn: 这一年，我们在《Big Walk》中与好友共度了快乐时光，体验了《Onimusha: Way of the Sword》业内顶尖的战斗。《007 初露锋芒》是自《GoldenEye》以来首款不容错过的邦德游戏，《火焰纹章：Fortune’s Wave》则带来了引人入胜的战术玩法和深入的社交机制，还有许多其他佳作。感觉主机周期已经到了这样一个阶段：开发者学会了如何充分发挥硬件性能，而我们现在终于能看到大家真正的本事。

paragraphs.en: Now Rockstar just needs to prove it’s the wizard it is and squeeze GTA 6 onto Switch 2 so we can play it on the loo. Please, Rockstar. I need this. On the loo.
paragraphs.cn: 现在，Rockstar只需要证明自己的确有魔法，把《GTA6》塞进Switch 2，让我们能坐在马桶上玩。拜托了，Rockstar。我需要这个。坐在马桶上玩。
